name: iam:PassRole + ecs:StartTask + ecs:RegisterContainerInstance
description: Register an EC2 instance to an ECS cluster and start an existing task definition with overrides to pass a privileged role and execute arbitrary container commands — no ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition required
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must cover both the task role ARN (override) and the execution role in the existing task definition
Register the EC2 instance to the target cluster via direct API call using IMDS identity documents
Start tasks on container instances in the target cluster

additional.description: Discover existing task definitions to exploit
Clean up orphaned container instance registrations

admin: Attacker has RCE on an EC2 instance whose role has the required permissions
An ECS cluster must exist in the account
An existing task definition must be available
A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
The EC2 instance must be registered to the cluster (this module handles the StartTask step; registration is a prerequisite)
lateral: Attacker has RCE on an EC2 instance whose role has the required permissions
An ECS cluster must exist in the account
An existing task definition must be available
A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com

references.title: Weaponizing AWS ECS Task Definitions to Steal Credentials From Running Containers

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass as taskRoleArn override (must trust ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com)

options.name: CLUSTER_NAME
options.description: ECS cluster name or ARN where the container instance is registered

options.name: TASK_DEFINITION
options.description: Existing ECS task definition family or ARN to exploit via --overrides

options.name: CONTAINER_INSTANCE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the container instance registered to the cluster (from ecs:RegisterContainerInstance)

options.name: CONTAINER_NAME
options.description: Name of the container in the existing task definition to override

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via ECS task container command
